label: pSC101 ori (SmaI/BglII vector form)
note: The SmaI/BglII cloning-vector form of the pSC101 origin: the native origin with CCCGGGAGATCT (SmaI + BglII) in place of its bases 32-43. Carried by the pZ expression vectors (Lutz & Bujard 1997) and by many later pSC101 vectors; 224 of a 1,390-plasmid collection carry this form and 44 the native one. The two differ only over bases 32-43, outside every annotated sub-element of the origin. Like the native form, it carries no temperature-sensitivity claim: that phenotype maps to the rep101 gene (Armstrong et al. 1984).

label: RepA iteron 1
note: First of three tandem ~18 bp direct-repeat iterons (shared 17 bp core TGTAAATTCTGCTAGAC).

label: RepA iteron 2
note: Second RepA-binding iteron; identical 17 bp core (TGTAAATTCTGCTAGAC) to iteron 1, differing only in the leading base (C->T).

label: RepA iteron 3
note: Third (innermost) RepA-binding iteron; differs from iterons 1/2 by a single central base (T->C, core CCGCTAGAC).

label: AT-rich bending region
note: AT-rich tract (82.4% AT) lying between the iterons and the DnaA box.

label: DnaA
note: DnaA-box-like motif on the reverse strand (revcomp of seq[211:220] = TTATACACA; near the DnaA consensus TTAT[C/A]CACA).

provenance.sequence_source: U66313 (expression vector pUHS*2Plac/ara-1 MCS1, Lutz & Bujard 1997), 2235..2457, 100% over 223 bp: the earliest deposit found that carries this form (the oldest 100% carrier a date-bracketed BLAST, 1980-2005, returns)

source.quote: The pSC101 origin of replication: the ~220 bp low-copy, iteron-driven cis origin that controls RepA-initiated replication of the narrow-host-range plasmid pSC101.
